component.name: AIDA Linux
component.summary: Hardware inspection and monitoring from sysfs/procfs
从 sysfs/procfs 采集的硬件检测与监控

description.p: Linux hardware information, sensor charts, microbenchmarks and JSON/HTML reports. Reads kernel files only; does not spawn dmidecode, lspci or smartctl.
Linux 硬件信息、传感器折线、微基准与 JSON/HTML 报告。只读内核文件，不调用 dmidecode / lspci / smartctl。
